acquisition_boundary: Reused pinned source archive and reviewed contributions; no acquired resources. Actual transitive/generated JVM prerequisites remain Phase 2.

immutable_handoff.rule: Phase 2 adds acquisitions to working research-manifest.json. Preserve frozen manifest, seal, expectations, inventory, contracts and fixture bytes/modes. Fresh review must bind the seal before execution.

artifact_hash_rule: This manifest binds contracts/inventory/expectations/all fixture files. The external Phase 1 seal binds both manifest versions, avoiding circular self hashes.
